title: tell the implementer in the brief that socket-bound packages fail inside its sandbox and that ork runs the suite itself, so its Tests line does not report sandbox failures

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The gate reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261119-230703-0874, project ork, item S417:

tell the implementer in the brief that socket-bound packages fail inside its sandbox and that ork runs the suite itself, so its Tests line does not report sandbox failures

Evidence: implementer-3 reports "Tests: 4084 passed, 212 failed", all from connect/setsockopt denials, while ork's checks-3.log is all ok
